Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Miscalculated the effect of halving m1 and halving r on gravitational force. Halving r increases force by 4, but halving m1 reduces it by 1/2, yielding a net factor of 2, not 4. This led to incorrectly selecting option A as the greatest increase instead of the correct option C (which yields an 8x increase).
